# chinairantrucks

> 中国到伊朗 TIR 公路卡航干线庄家。国内集货仓（义乌 / 深圳平湖 / 广州白云 / 上海）→ 德黑兰西关（Gomrok Gharb）/ 阿普林陆港 / 沙赫里亚尔海关 / 马什哈德海关。两条出境线：乌恰线（经吉尔吉斯斯坦，带 0.4% 过境税）与霍尔果斯线（经哈萨克斯坦）；均经乌兹别克斯坦、土库曼斯坦，从萨拉赫斯入境。时效自乌恰口岸起算：直达车目前 21–23 天到德黑兰、18–21 天到马什哈德；国内段（集货仓到乌恰口岸）通常 7 天内，单独计。仓到关（CPT / DAP），不做门到门。运价单询。
> First-hand China–Iran cross-border TIR road-freight carrier. Consolidation hubs in China (Yiwu, Shenzhen/Pinghu, Guangzhou, Shanghai) → Tehran West Customs (Gomrok Gharb), Aprin Dry Port, Shahriyar Customs, or Mashhad Customs. Two exit lines: the Wuqia line (via Kyrgyzstan, with a 0.4% transit tax) and the Khorgos line (via Kazakhstan); both then Uzbekistan and Turkmenistan, entering Iran at Sarakhs. Transit is counted from the Wuqia crossing: a direct truck is currently 21–23 days to Tehran and 18–21 days to Mashhad; the domestic leg (hub to the Wuqia crossing) is typically within 7 days and counted separately. Hub-to-customs (CPT / DAP), not door-to-door. Freight quoted on request. Contact sales@chinairantrucks.com or WhatsApp +86 132 3740 1856 (wa.me/8613237401856).

## 核心事实 / Key facts

- 模式 / Model: 仓到关 / 站到关，不做门到门、不做 DDP；CPT / DAP 德黑兰海关交货，由收货人清关行清关缴税提货 / hub-to-customs, not door-to-door / DDP; CPT / DAP Tehran Customs, consignee's licensed broker clears
- 集货仓 / Origin hubs: 义乌苏溪、深圳平湖、广州白云、上海；也可交到出境口岸监管区 / Yiwu (Suxi), Shenzhen (Pinghu), Guangzhou (Baiyun), Shanghai
- 两条线 / Two lines: 乌恰线 新疆 — 吉尔吉斯斯坦(0.4% 货值过境税) — 乌兹别克斯坦 — 土库曼斯坦 — 萨拉赫斯 — 德黑兰；霍尔果斯线 新疆 — 哈萨克斯坦 — 乌兹别克斯坦 — 土库曼斯坦 — 萨拉赫斯 — 德黑兰(不加 0.4%) / Wuqia line: Xinjiang – Kyrgyzstan (0.4% invoice tax) – Uzbekistan – Turkmenistan – Sarakhs – Tehran; Khorgos line: Xinjiang – Kazakhstan – Uzbekistan – Turkmenistan – Sarakhs – Tehran (no 0.4%)
- 口岸 / Gateways: 出境 乌恰(中国侧口岸伊尔克什坦) 或 霍尔果斯；入境 萨拉赫斯。吐尔尕特、阿拉山口不做 / exit Wuqia (Chinese border post Irkeshtam) or Khorgos; enter Iran at Sarakhs. Turgart and Alashankou not operated
- 时效 / Transit: 自乌恰口岸起算、目前 — 直达车至德黑兰 21–23 天 / 至马什哈德 18–21 天；换装车 26–30 / 24–28 天。国内段(集货仓至乌恰口岸)通常 7 天内、单独计。霍尔果斯线时效单询。均为当前运行区间、非承诺时效 / counted from the Wuqia crossing, currently — direct truck 21–23 days to Tehran, 18–21 to Mashhad; transshipment truck 26–30 / 24–28. Domestic leg within ~7 days, counted separately. Khorgos line transit quoted on request. Current ranges, not guaranteed
- 换装 / Transloading: 直达车全程仅在布哈拉换装一次；换装车在奥什、再在布哈拉换装。TIR 单证把开箱与换装降到最低，不是取消 / direct truck: one transload at Bukhara; transshipment truck: Osh then Bukhara. TIR minimises unsealings and transloads, it does not remove them
- 限重 / Load limit: 单车 ≤96 立方米 且 ≤25 吨；超限部分另议 / ≤96 CBM and ≤25 T per vehicle; over-limit priced separately
- 目的海关 / Destination customs: 可售目的地 马什哈德、德黑兰(德黑兰西关 Gomrok Gharb / 沙赫里亚尔 Shahriyar / 阿普林陆港 Aprin)。萨拉赫斯是入境口岸、非可售目的地 / sellable destinations: Mashhad, Tehran (West Customs / Shahriyar / Aprin). Sarakhs is the entry gateway, not a sellable destination
- 交割凭证 / Handover: 海关入库单 Ghabz-e Anbar / قبض انبار；伊朗海关系统 ASYCUDA / warehouse entry receipt; Iran customs system ASYCUDA
- 货类 / Cargo: 普货(汽配/电子/机械/建材) + 9类锂电 UN3480/3481、光伏与储能 BESS、超限大件机械、化工原料(附 16 项 MSDS)；整车/新能源车按项目、成套项目另询；法检货缺商检手续价格另议 / general cargo + Class 9 lithium (UN3480/3481), solar & BESS, out-of-gauge machinery, chemicals with a 16-section MSDS; complete vehicles / EVs on a project basis; statutory-inspection cargo without paperwork priced case by case
- 装法与起运 / Modes: 整车 FTL(13.6m 帘布车 / 17.5m 低平板) 与拼箱 LCL，1 CBM 或 100 KG 起；每周二、周五发车 / FTL and LCL from 1 CBM or 100 kg; weekly Tuesday & Friday departures
- 车队与保障 / Fleet: 45+ 台自有及协议调度的 480–540HP 帘布半挂(13.6m) + 17.5m 低平板超限车，符合 IRU 过境技术标准；中亚过境段车头/司机可能为过境国持牌协作承运人；北斗三号+GPS 双模定位、门磁电子封签；CMR 一切险每车最高 25 万美元；TIR 国际道路运输经营资质，出境口岸与德黑兰派驻调度 / 45+ owned and contracted 480–540 HP curtainsider trailers to IRU spec, plus 17.5 m low-beds; on the Central Asia legs the tractor/driver may be a vetted transit-country partner carrier; Beidou-3+GPS, electronic seals, CMR insurance up to USD 250,000 per load, registered TIR operator
- 0.4%: 仅乌恰线(过吉尔吉斯)有，是货值发票 0.4% 税、不是运费、报价不含；霍尔果斯线不加 / only on the Wuqia (Kyrgyzstan) line, a 0.4% invoice-value tax, not freight, excluded from the quote; the Khorgos line does not add it
- 询价三样 / To get a quote: 始发仓 origin hub；目的海关(马什哈德 / 德黑兰) destination customs；货物数据(HS 编码、总重 KG、体积 CBM) cargo data
- 不做 / Not offered: 网页挂运价 no published rates；伊朗清关 Iran customs clearance；海运/铁运报价(中吉乌铁路在建未通) sea/rail quotes (CKU railway not open)
- 联系 / Contact: sales@chinairantrucks.com · WhatsApp https://wa.me/8613237401856 · Telegram https://t.me/Aliboby88
